ld.name: NOW Foods, Liposomal Vitamin C, 120 Veg Capsules (500 mg per Capsule)
ld.description: Immune & Collagen Support Enhanced Absorption and Retention Fat-Soluble Vitamin C Liposomal PureWay C™ Dietary Supplement Vegetarian/Vegan Non-GMO Kosher Vitamins Family Owned Since 1968 GMP Quality Assured NOW® Liposomal Vitamin C features Liposomal PureWay-C™, vitamin C in a fat-soluble delivery system that has demonstrated enhanced absorption, cellular uptake, and bodily retention in clinical studies as compared to other forms of vitamin C. Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that is also necessary for collagen synthesis, the maintenance of capillary and blood vessel integrity, cartilage and bone health, normal immune function, and nerve impulse transmission.

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: NOW® Liposomal Vitamin C features Liposomal PureWay-C™, vitamin C in a fat-soluble delivery system that has demonstrated enhanced absorption, cellular uptake, and bodily retention in clinical studies as compared to other forms of vitamin C. Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that is also necessary for collagen synthesis, the maintenance of capillary and blood vessel integrity, cartilage and bone health, normal immune function, and nerve impulse transmission.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 2 capsules daily with a meal.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Hypromellose (cellulose capsule), microcrystalline cellulose, phospholipids (from sunflower lecithin), fatty acids (from rice bran), magnesium stearate (vegetable source), stearic acid (vegetable source), silicon dioxide and citrus bioflavonoids.
Made and quality tested in the USA with globally sourced ingredients.
Not manufactured with wheat, gluten, soy, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients. Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place after opening.
Natural color variation may occur in this product.
For adults only. Consult physician if pregnant/nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition. Keep out of reach of children.
